systemPrompt: You are producing visual-development art for a playable Napoleonic real-time strategy game. Preserve a consistent high-angle top-down / 2.5D strategy-camera language, semi-realistic painterly rendering, muted historical palette, clean silhouettes, readable regiment structure, coherent soft sunlight and contact shadows, and strong gameplay readability at distance. Avoid cinematic close-ups and avoid decorative detail that obscures tactical information. Keep proportions, terrain scale, facing direction and formation spacing believable. No UI, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
avoid: Avoid: cinematic close-up framing, first-person view, fantasy armor, modern weapons, science-fiction elements, bright cartoon palette, oversized smoke, unreadable silhouettes, chaotic overlapping formations, giant props, inconsistent perspective, distorted anatomy, duplicate limbs, malformed horses, text, UI, logos, watermarks.

categories.prompt: A polished battlefield style keyframe for a Napoleonic RTS. French and British line infantry face each other in organized regiments, with one cavalry formation and one artillery battery. Grassy rolling terrain, dirt roads, sparse trees, hedges and a small rural village. Musket and cannon smoke are atmospheric but never obscure formation readability. Clear facing, spacing, unit hierarchy and tactical lanes. This image defines the visual North Star for the whole game.

Napoleonic RTS terrain study from the same high-angle 2.5D strategy camera: readable European grassland with subtle dry and damp variation, worn patches, low undulation, tiny stones and restrained vegetation. Designed as a repeatable game-terrain reference with low visual noise and enough material richness to avoid a flat green field.

Napoleonic RTS dirt-road terrain study from the same high-angle 2.5D camera. A historically believable unpaved military road integrated into grassland, with compacted wheel ruts, soft shoulders, muddy/dry variation, sparse verge plants and natural blending into surrounding terrain. Gameplay-readable and suitable as a texture/material reference.

Small early-19th-century European village for a Napoleonic RTS, viewed from a high-angle 2.5D strategy camera. A coherent cluster of modest houses, barns, gardens, hedges, yards, trees and connecting dirt tracks. Buildings read clearly at RTS scale with consistent sunlight/contact shadows and restrained detail. No modern objects.

French Napoleonic line infantry regiment visual-development sheet rendered as an in-game high-angle 2.5D formation. Dense but readable ordered ranks, historically grounded blue uniform massing, shakos, packs, muskets, a subtle eagle/standard and officer cues. The formation silhouette and facing direction must be readable before individual soldier detail.

British Napoleonic line infantry regiment visual-development sheet rendered as an in-game high-angle 2.5D formation. Dense but readable ordered ranks, historically grounded red-coat massing, shakos, packs, muskets, regimental colour and restrained officer cues. Clearly distinct from French infantry while sharing the same game-art style and scale.

Napoleonic cavalry regiment game-art study from a high-angle 2.5D RTS camera. Organized mounted formation with strong directional silhouette, believable horse spacing, subtle motion weight and soft ground shadows. Historically grounded uniforms and tack, restrained detail, designed to remain recognizable while zoomed out.

Napoleonic field artillery battery game-art study from a high-angle 2.5D RTS camera. One cannon with historically grounded carriage proportions, crew arranged in readable working positions, ammunition/support props kept sparse, clear facing and soft contact shadows. Designed for tactical readability and a consistent semi-realistic painterly style.

Black-powder combat VFX reference for a Napoleonic RTS from the same high-angle 2.5D camera: short restrained musket muzzle flashes, layered white-grey volley smoke, one artillery discharge with compact flash, recoil suggestion and low dust. Effects enhance atmosphere without hiding units, selection space or regiment silhouettes.
